scope: Proposition 2.1 (Signed momentum increments) of the manuscript “Global classical solutions of the three-dimensional relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system” (preprints/Global-classical-solutions-of-the-three-dimensional-relativistic-Vlasov-Maxwell-system-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 362 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 56691a44941097fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 5-6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each smooth admissible datum and finite T0, there are constants M, A ≥ 1 and P0 with the following property. On every compact classical solution interval [0, t∗] as above, for every dyadic P ≥ P0 satisfying (2.1), 5 every supported receiver, every w = 2k, k ≥ 0, and every interval [t1, t2] ⊂ [0, t∗] on which w/8 ≤ qX(t) ≤ 8w throughout, one has |VX(t2) − VX(t1)| ≤ MP √ t2 − t1 + A(t2 − t1)S(w). (2.2) The constants are independent of t∗ and P.
